title: How a request to /docs/aad-docs/overview/ becomes a page

steps.title: The URL is matched
steps.detail: aad_docs:page matches the node slug 'aad-docs' and the page path 'overview'.

steps.title: Access is checked
steps.detail: DocsAccessMixin applies the ACCESS setting. By default only staff users continue.

steps.title: The node tree is loaded
steps.detail: build_tree() returns the cached tree. On first use it walks INSTALLED_APPS, finds each docs/ with an __init__.py and resolves its node.

steps.title: The address is resolved
steps.detail: resolve_path() finds the node 'aad-docs' and reads 'overview' as a section, a model or a page, in that order. An unknown slug returns 404.

steps.title: The language variant is picked
steps.detail: pick_variant() returns 01-overview.es.md when Spanish is active and the file exists, else 01-overview.md.

steps.title: The file is read
steps.detail: read_page() picks the Markdown reader, which renders HTML and keeps Mermaid blocks for the browser.

steps.title: The page is drawn
steps.detail: PageView passes the tree and the page to page_md.html. The menu comes from the tree; Mermaid runs in the browser.
